data.one_liner: A flutter plugin to open a web page with Chrome Custom Tabs and SFSafariViewController.
data.what_it_does: It allows Flutter applications to open web pages using native browser components such as Chrome Custom Tabs on Android and SFSafariViewController on iOS. It offers various configuration options for UI customization like colors, bar collapsing, and share states.
use_when: You want to open external web links inside your app using native browser tabs rather than launching a full external browser or a heavy webview.
You need to customize the appearance of Chrome Custom Tabs or Safari View Controller on mobile platforms.
avoid_when: You need an in-app embedded WebView widget to render custom HTML or interact heavily with web content inside your widget tree.
You are targeting non-mobile platforms where Chrome Custom Tabs and SFSafariViewController are not supported.
strengths: Provides a seamless native browsing experience on Android and iOS.
Supports rich customization options for both Android and iOS browser views.
Includes features like warm-up APIs and event handling for Safari redirect and close.
weaknesses: APIs might change as the plugin is under development.
Limited to specific native browser implementations on Android and iOS.
data.setup_notes: Install the library from pub and import it in your Dart code.
